investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-06-27T04:17–04:24Z because every pod submitted for remote agent creation was rejected as Unschedulable: the 2 nodes carrying the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource reported insufficient capacity, and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. No evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected by any check, confirming the agent VM was never provisioned.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes scheduler could not place the remote-agent pod on any of the 6 available nodes. Two nodes advertise the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource but have no remaining allocatable capacity; four nodes are excluded by the pod's node affinity or node selector. Preemption was also exhausted (no victims found on the 2 eligible nodes; not applicable on the 4 affinity-mismatched nodes). Because the pod never became Running, the eval runner's createAgent call (run-status-probes.mjs line 1885) timed out after ~120 s without writing any evidence, causing a complete contract gap for all four required fields. This is an eval-detected infrastructure capacity constraint, not a confirmed user-facing outage — no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the evidence.

investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes scheduler could not place the remote-agent pod on any of the 6 available nodes. Two nodes advertise the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource but have no remaining allocatable capacity; four nodes are excluded by the pod's node affinity or node selector. Preemption was also exhausted (no victims found on the 2 eligible nodes; not applicable on the 4 affinity-mismatched nodes). Because the pod never became Running, the eval runner's createAgent call (run-status-probes.mjs line 1885) timed out after ~120 s without writing any evidence, causing a complete contract gap for all four required fields. This is an eval-detected infrastructure capacity constraint, not a confirmed user-facing outage — no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the evidence.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigations.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-06-27T04:19–04:24Z because every pod submitted by the eval runner was rejected by the Kubernetes scheduler: 2 of 6 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. Because no pod ever reached a running state, the remote agent VM was never provisioned, and the eval produced zero evidence — all five required fields (orgId, agentId, model, provider, message) are missing from the check result.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the two nodes that carry that resource type. The scheduler message "0/6 nodes are available: 2 Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector" (evidence: failed-check.message, sibling.remote-agent-create, sibling.remote-agent-state) is identical across all three sibling checks, confirming the failure is at the infrastructure scheduling layer, not in the eval runner logic or the expected-output contract definition. The eval never advanced past pod scheduling, so no runtime response was produced and the contract gap (evidence: expected-output.missing-required-evidence) is a downstream consequence of the scheduling failure, not an independent bug.

Secondary — node affinity/selector mismatch on the remaining 4 nodes: the remote-agent pod spec requires a node label or taint that only the 2 kata-capable nodes satisfy, so even if VM capacity were freed, the 4 other nodes would still be ineligible.
